text:
mina: Hi finance — grabbed cash in Tokyo last night because the taxi at the station only accepted cash. ATM charged a 220 JPY fee + 3% foreign transaction fee (card saw a network fee too). Total hit was ~¥4,320 on my corp card. Can ATM/withdrawal fees be reimbursed? I attached the ATM receipt and the card portal line (txn id JP-990221).

ajay_finance: thanks @mina. short answer: ATM fees are reimbursable only for business-critical cash where no card acceptance was possible (policy section: https://policies.redwood.company/expenses#cash-and-atm-fees). We need manager attestation that cash was required and a short justification. Please submit expense as two lines: 1) Cash withdrawal amount (net of fees) and 2) ATM/network fees as separate line with note "ATM/network fees - reimbursable per exception". Attach ATM receipt and merchant/card txns.

lily_manager: confirming — this was for taxi and small vendor payments during the on-site visit; i attest cash was necessary. approving reimbursement.

mina: thanks. slightly confusing on amounts — the card portal shows a single settled USD charge of $41.23. ATM receipt lists ¥220 fee and cash dispensed ¥10,000. do i enter the cash line as 10,000 JPY and the fee as 220 JPY?

ajay_finance: yes please. include both JPY lines and the settled USD value in the notes so we can reconcile. Example expense lines to enter:

```
Line 1: Cash withdrawal - 10,000 JPY - Payment method: Corporate Card - Receipt: ATM slip - Notes: card settled USD $37.50 (txn JP-990221)
Line 2: ATM/network fees - 220 JPY - Payment method: Corporate Card - Receipt: ATM slip - Notes: reimbursable per manager attestation (lily_manager) and policy link
```

mina: submitted with manager attestation and attached the ATM receipt + card portal screenshot. opsbot, can you open an audit ticket so we keep this as an exception record?

opsbot: Ticket created: EXP-ATMF-2026-12. Labels: atm-fee, manager-exception. Linked expense: EXP-2026-905. Reminder scheduled in 14 days to confirm reconciliation with card provider.

travelbot: FYI travel tip: if you expect cash-only payments abroad, request a petty cash advance or small cash allowance via the travel portal to avoid multiple ATM fees. https://travel.redwood.company/cash-advances

ajay_finance: I'll process reimbursement as an exception once the ticket is validated. if card provider shows a separate network fee reversal later, we'll adjust. ETA payout: next reimburse cycle. :bank:
